executorMemory.description: Amount of memory to allocate to each executor. e.g. '1G'

executorCores.description: Number of CPU cores on each executor.

driverMemory.description: Amount of memory to allocate to the driver. e.g. '1G'

driverCores.description: Number of CPU cores to allocate to the driver.

id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

instance.description: The parent {@link ExMachinaInstance} which used these settings

executorMemoryOverhead.description: Amount of executor memory to allocate to overhead.

driverMemoryOverhead.description: Amount of driver memory to allocate to overhead.

memorySize.description:
The Spark memory size
Note: this may not match the actual values if the fields of the persisted ExMachinaMemorySize have changes since
the ExMachinaInstance.Settings was created.

image.description: The image used for the driver pod

sparkK8sNamespaceName.description: Namespace that will be used for running the driver and executor pods

title: The {@link ExMachinaInstance#settings} that are never edited directly by the user, because these are used for billing.
name: ExMachinaInstance.Settings
